ideas.title: The Impact of Funding Freezes on Local Economies
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the Trump administration's funding freezes on local economies and infrastructure development.
questions: What are the economic implications of the funding freezes?
How will the affected projects be completed?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a larger pattern of mismanagement by the Trump administration, and could lead to further investigations into the administration's handling of infrastructure projects.
